units.source_text: 语言甚多，老夫人未能毕读。

en.t: The letter was very long, and the old lady could not read it through to the end.

units.source_text: 这信态度很不明显，话中似有得意之色，而今宵又淡然不再来访。

en.t: The tone of the letter was quite unclear; there seemed to be a hint of satisfaction in the words, yet tonight he calmly failed to visit again.

units.source_text: 老夫人看了信很不高兴。

en.t: After reading the letter, the old lady was very displeased.

units.source_text: 她仔细寻思：“从前卫门督对公主爱情冷淡，我很伤心。

en.t: She pondered carefully: "In the past, when the Captain of the Gate showed little affection for the princess, I was deeply saddened.

units.source_text: 然而他表面上对她异常尊重。

en.t: Yet outwardly he treated her with extraordinary respect.

units.source_text: 全靠如此，聊可慰情，尚且很不称心。

en.t: Only because of that could I find a little comfort, and even then I was far from satisfied.

units.source_text: 现在此人态度如此，如何是好！

en.t: Now that this man behaves in such a way, what is to be done!

units.source_text: 前太政大臣家的人闻知此事，不知作何感想。”

en.t: If the people of the former Chancellor's household hear of this, I wonder what they will think."

units.source_text: 又想：“我总得探探他的口气，看他如何说法。”

en.t: Then she thought, "I must at least sound him out and see what he has to say."

units.source_text: 便不管心情颓丧，勉强擦擦眼睛，执笔代为作复，

en.t: So, despite her despondent mood, she forced herself to wipe her eyes, took up the brush, and wrote a reply on the princess's behalf,

units.source_text: 写出来的字奇形怪状，好像鸟迹。

en.t: but the characters she wrote were strangely misshapen, like the tracks of birds.

units.source_text: 信中言道：“老身病势垂危，公主亲来探望。

en.t: The letter said: "My illness has become critical, and the princess came in person to visit me.
Just at that time, I received and read your letter.

units.source_text: 苦劝公主作复，其奈心情愁闷，不能执笔。

en.t: I earnestly urged the princess to write a reply, but she is so distressed that she cannot take up the brush.

units.source_text: 老身未便坐视，只得代为奉答：

en.t: I could not simply sit by and watch, so I have no choice but to answer respectfully on her behalf:
